verse.verse_2: And striking off fire by dashing their hoofs.
verse.verse_5: And cleaving their way therein into the host,
verse.verse_6: Verily man is Unto his Lord ungrateful.
verse.verse_7: And verily to that he is witness.
verse.verse_8: And verily in the love of wealth he is vehement,
verse.verse_9: Knoweth he not - when that which is in the graves, shall be ransacked?
verse.verse_10: And there shall be brounht to light that which is in the breasts?
verse.verse_11: Verily their Lord on that Day will be of them Aware.
